subject: DI04000251

h.en: 1.1.1 Design means justify the size, not guess it
h.gu: 1.1.1 Design એટલે Sizeનું કારણ આપવું,અંદાજ નહિ

body.en:
Start with the situation

Two rods look identical, but one carries a steady load and the other repeated shock. The same diameter need not be safe for both.

Definition / principle

Machine-element design selects material, shape, size and details to satisfy a defined duty with acceptable safety, function and manufacturability.

Understand why

A design statement needs the load model, allowable stresses, failure modes, dimensions and a final verification.

Application / illustration

A larger part may be stronger but heavier, costlier or incompatible with the assembly; design balances constraints.

Common mistake / conditions

A worked classroom example is not a certified product design; real equipment needs applicable standards and competent review.

Is standardisation only rounding dimensions?

No. It also covers materials, products, interfaces, tolerances and interchangeability.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

બે rods દેખાવે same હોય,પણ એક steady load,બીજો repeated shock લે.બન્ને માટે same diameter safe હોય જરૂરી નહિ.

Definition / Principle

Machine-element designમાં defined duty માટે safety,function,manufacturability જાળવી material,shape,size,details પસંદ થાય.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Design statementમાં load model,allowable stresses,failure modes,dimensions,final verification જોઈએ.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

મોટો part stronger હોય,પણ heavier,costlier કે assemblyને unsuitable હોય;design constraintsનું balance છે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Classroom example certified product design નથી;real equipmentમાં applicable standards,competent review જોઈએ.

Standardisation ફક્ત Dimensions Round કરવી છે?

ના.Materials,products,interfaces,tolerances,interchangeability પણ આવે.

h.gu: 1.1.2 Design Process:Standard Size પછી ફરી Check

body.en:
Definition / principle

Begin with requirements and finish with a checked drawing and specification.

Understand why

Define function, life, environment, interfaces, load magnitudes/directions and operating cases.

Draw a free-body diagram; identify critical sections and possible tension, shear, bearing, bending, torsion or stability failure.

Select material and appropriate allowable criteria; calculate trial dimensions with stated assumptions.

Choose available standard sizes, check fit and manufacture, then recalculate every governing stress/deflection.

Prepare dimensions, tolerances, finish, material, heat treatment and inspection notes; review the full assembly.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Requirementsથી શરૂ કરીને checked drawing,specification સુધી જાઓ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Function,life,environment,interfaces,load magnitude/direction,operating cases નક્કી કરો.

Free-body diagram દોરો;critical sections,tension,shear,bearing,bending,torsion,stability failure ઓળખો.

Material,appropriate allowable criteria પસંદ કરો;assumptions સાથે trial dimensions ગણો.

Available standard sizes,fit,manufacture જુઓ;પછી દરેક governing stress/deflection ફરી ગણો.

Dimensions,tolerances,finish,material,heat treatment,inspection notes આપો;full assembly review કરો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Strength is one requirement among several.

Understand why

Rigidity, deflection, vibration, wear, fatigue, corrosion and temperature can govern before static yielding.

Material availability, cost, production quantity, casting/forging/machining and joining influence shape and tolerances.

Assembly, interchangeability, lubrication, inspection, repair and safe access affect the complete lifecycle.

Use risk-appropriate standards and review; neither low cost nor a large factor of safety excuses an incorrect model.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Strength અનેક requirementsમાંથી એક છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Static yielding પહેલાં rigidity,deflection,vibration,wear,fatigue,corrosion,temperature governing બની શકે.

Availability,cost,quantity,casting/forging/machining,joining shape,tolerancesને અસર કરે.

Assembly,interchangeability,lubrication,inspection,repair,safe access lifecycleને અસર કરે.

Risk મુજબ standards,review લો;low cost કે મોટો factor of safety ખોટા modelને યોગ્ય નથી બનાવતો.

h.en: 1.1.4 Materials:choose properties for the failure mode

body.en:
Definition / principle

Material choice must match stress type, temperature, environment and manufacturing route.

Understand why

Low/medium-carbon steels offer useful strength, toughness and machinability; heat treatment changes properties.

Cast iron suits suitable rigid/compressive/vibration-damping parts but brittle tensile behaviour needs care.

Alloy steels can provide higher strength/hardenability; stainless steels improve selected corrosion duties, not every environment.

Bronzes and bearing alloys suit selected sliding contacts; aluminium alloys reduce mass; polymers/composites need creep/temperature checks.

Distinguish yield strength, ultimate strength, modulus, hardness, toughness and fatigue strength; none is a substitute for all others.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Material choice stress type,temperature,environment,manufacturing routeને match થવી જોઈએ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Low/medium-carbon steelમાં strength,toughness,machinability મળે;heat treatmentથી properties બદલાય.

Cast iron suitable rigid/compressive/vibration-damping partsમાં;બ્રિટલ tensile behaviourમાં કાળજી જોઈએ.

Alloy steel વધુ strength/hardenability આપે;stainless selected corrosion dutyમાં સારું,દરેક environmentમાં નહિ.

Bronze,bearing alloy selected sliding contactમાં;aluminium mass ઘટાડે;polymer/compositeમાં creep/temperature જુઓ.

Yield,ultimate strength,modulus,hardness,toughness,fatigue strength જુદાં છે;એકથી બધું substitute નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A load is external action; stress is internal force intensity at a section.

Understand why

Axial force produces normal stress; transverse force produces shear and generally bending; torque produces torsional shear.

Steady, gradually applied, sudden, impact, repeated and reversed describe loading histories, not different units.

Normal stress may be tensile or compressive; shear acts tangentially. Bearing/crushing stress uses a specified projected contact area.

Use N, mm, Nmm and MPa consistently:1MPa=1N/mm²; do not mix a kN load directly with mm².
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Load external action છે;stress section પર internal force intensity છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Axial force normal stress આપે;transverse force shear,સામાન્ય રીતે bending આપે;torque torsional shear આપે.

Steady,gradual,sudden,impact,repeated,reversed load history બતાવે,જુદા units નહિ.

Normal stress tensile/compressive હોય;shear tangential હોય.Bearing/crushing માટે specified projected contact area લો.

N,mm,Nmm,MPa consistent લો:1MPa=1N/mm²;kNને સીધું mm² સાથે ન વાપરો.

h.en: 1.1.6 Factor of safety and allowable stress
h.gu: 1.1.6 Factor of Safety અને Allowable Stress

body.en:
Definition / principle

A factor of safety relates an appropriate limiting strength to allowable stress under a defined criterion.

Understand why

For a stated ductile static tensile-yield check, allowable normal stress=Sy/n.

For brittle materials, ultimate strength and tensile/compressive asymmetry may matter; fatigue needs a different model.

Allowable shear is not automatically equal to allowable tension; it depends on material, criterion and supplied design data.

Uncertainty, consequence, load variation, inspection and standards influence the selected factor; there is no universal safe value for every machine.

Can an arbitrary large n fix a forgotten bending moment?

No. The load/failure model must be correct first.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Defined criterionમાં appropriate limiting strengthને allowable stress સાથે factor of safety જોડે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Stated ductile static tensile-yield checkમાં allowable normal stress=Sy/n.

Brittle materialમાં ultimate strength,tension/compression asymmetry મહત્વની;fatigue માટે જુદું model જોઈએ.

Allowable shear=allowable tension આપમેળે નહિ;material,criterion,given data પર આધારિત.

Uncertainty,consequence,load variation,inspection,standards factor નક્કી કરે;દરેક machine માટે universal safe value નથી.

મનફાવે તેટલો મોટો n ભૂલાયેલ Bending Moment સુધારે?

ના.પહેલાં load/failure model સાચું જોઈએ.

h.en: 1.1.7 Allowable stress and a trial rod

body.en:
Given and model

Steady axial P20kN, ductile yield240MPa, n3; ignore holes, bending and fatigue.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Allowable stress=240/3=80MPa
  2. Required area=20000/80=250mm²
  3. dmin=sqrt(4×250/pi)=17.8412mm
  4. Choose d20mm:stress=20000/(pi×20²/4)=63.6620MPa

Common mistake / conditions

State that the20mm trial passes this nominal direct-yield check only; fit, fatigue and other failures remain to be reviewed.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Steady axial P20kN,ductile yield240MPa,n3;holes,bending,fatigue અવગણો.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Allowable stress=240/3=80MPa
  2. Required area=20000/80=250mm²
  3. dmin=sqrt(4×250/pi)=17.8412mm
  4. Choose d20mm:stress=20000/(pi×20²/4)=63.6620MPa

Common Mistake / શરતો

20mm ફક્ત આ nominal direct-yield checkમાં pass થાય;fit,fatigue,બીજા failures review કરવાના છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Holes, fillets, keyways and sharp changes disturb otherwise smooth stress flow.

Understand why

Elastic theoretical factor Kt=sigma peak/sigma nominal for the stated geometry and load.

The nominal stress must use the reference area defined by the chart; net-area and gross-area factors are not interchangeable.

Larger appropriate fillets, smoother transitions and better detail placement can reduce concentration, subject to fit/function.

Fatigue notch sensitivity and plastic redistribution are separate issues; do not apply one elasticKt blindly to every failure mode.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Holes,fillets,keyways,sharp changes smooth stress flow બગાડે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Stated geometry/load માટે elastic theoretical Kt=sigma peak/sigma nominal.

Chartમાં defined reference areaથી nominal stress લો;net/gross-area factors interchangeable નથી.

Fit/functionની અંદર suitable fillet,smooth transition,detail placement concentration ઘટાડે.

Fatigue notch sensitivity,plastic redistribution અલગ છે;દરેક failureમાં એક elastic Kt અંધપણે નહિ.

body.en:
Given and model

P10kN, plate width40mm, thickness5mm; given Kt2.4 based explicitly on gross area.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Gross area=40×5=200mm²; nominal stress=10000/200=50MPa
  2. Elastic peak=2.4×50=120MPa

Common mistake / conditions

Do not subtract the hole area while retaining a gross-area-based Kt; that would change the reference twice.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

P10kN,plate width40mm,thickness5mm;given Kt2.4 gross area પર આધારિત છે.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Gross area=40×5=200mm²;nominal stress=10000/200=50MPa
  2. Elastic peak=2.4×50=120MPa

Common Mistake / શરતો

Gross-area Kt રાખીને hole area ન બાદ કરો;reference બમણી વાર બદલાઈ જાય.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Standardisation reduces unnecessary variety; preferred numbers give a rational approximately geometric size series.

Understand why

Renard basic seriesR5, R10, R20, R40 have5,10,20,40intervals per decade; ideal ratioq=10^(1/R).

Rounded R5 values in one decade are1.00,1.60,2.50,4.00,6.30,10.00; multiply by powers of10 for another range.

Derived series select regular steps from a basic series; consult the specified preferred-number table for actual rounded values.

A preferred number is not automatically an available shaft/key/bearing standard size; check the applicable product standard too.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Standardisation બિનજરૂરી variety ઘટાડે;preferred numbers rational approximately geometric size series આપે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Renard R5,R10,R20,R40માં decadeદીઠ5,10,20,40intervals;ideal ratio q=10^(1/R).

એક decadeના rounded R5 values1.00,1.60,2.50,4.00,6.30,10.00;બીજા range માટે10ની powersથી multiply કરો.

Derived series basic seriesમાંથી regular steps લે;actual rounded values માટે specified table લો.

Preferred number આપમેળે available shaft/key/bearing standard size નથી;product standard પણ જુઓ.

body.en:
Given and model

Use the stated rounded R5 table; list values from20to80mm and choose a size for required strength diameter34mm.

Step-by-step solution

  1. R5 decade10–100:10,16,25,40,63,100mm
  2. Values within20–80:25,40,63mm
  3. For required d≥34mm:select40mm, not25mm

Common mistake / conditions

A maximum-space constraint may conflict with rounding upward; resolve the design instead of silently violating a requirement.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Given rounded R5 table લો;20થી80mmના values લખો,required strength diameter34mm માટે size પસંદ કરો.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. R5 decade10–100:10,16,25,40,63,100mm
  2. Values within20–80:25,40,63mm
  3. For required d≥34mm:select40mm,not25mm

Common Mistake / શરતો

Maximum-space constraint upward rounding સાથે conflict કરે તો design સુધારો;requirement ચૂપચાપ ન તોડો.

h.gu: 1.1.12 ફરી વાપરી શકાય એવો Design-answer Template

body.en:
Definition / principle

Write an auditable calculation, not an unexplained final diameter.

Understand why

Given→FBD→material/allowables→failure area→equation→minimum size→selected standard size.

Recheck stress, deflection, fit, clearance and other linked failure modes using selected dimensions.

Conclude with units, assumptions and scope:passes the stated checks, not guaranteed safe in all service conditions.

Should a strength minimum be rounded down?

No, not without a justified redesign and recheck.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Unexplained final diameter નહિ,auditable calculation લખો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Given→FBD→material/allowables→failure area→equation→minimum size→selected standard size.

Selected dimensionsથી stress,deflection,fit,clearance,linked failures ફરી check કરો.

Units,assumptions,scope સાથે conclude કરો:stated checks pass,દરેક serviceમાં guaranteed safe નહિ.

Strength Minimumને નીચે Round કરાય?

ના,justified redesign,recheck વગર નહિ.
